_readme: Parameters of the seeded synthetic pedigree generator (scripts/generate_world.py). Published with the repo so anyone can regenerate the eval worlds. Every person, clinician and organisation produced is synthetic and labelled (fictional).

Calibration: values marked source are taken from the literature cited; values marked assumption are our illustrative choices, stated as such in the README. The generator never reads real patient data.
Determinism: the same seed and the same scenario list produce byte-identical lab.json and hs.json (sorted keys, stable id scheme). The RNG is Python random.Random(seed); numpy is not used.

half_sibship_prob.note: probability that a parent has children with a second partner

two_proband_family_prob.note: a second carrier with a report from this lab in the same family (exercises algo.WCC merge, query A2)

genetics.model: gene drop from one founder carrier chosen uniformly among the proband's four grandparents; Mendelian transmission with probability 0.5 per meiosis; no de novo; complete detectability of the variant by testing
genetics.applies_to: scenarios whose gene has inheritance AD and review_always false; other genes still get pedigrees (their relatives must come out NEEDS_REVIEW)

first_degree_tested_prob.source: Frey MK et al., J Clin Oncol 2022: 41% of at-risk relatives completed cascade testing across 87 studies

carrier_decision_prob.note: a Decision resting on the class at issue (surveillance, surgery recommendation)

first_degree_relative_decision_prob.note: e.g. discharged from screening while the variant was a VUS
